verdict.rationale: Telemetry and usage-tracking opt-out is a fair question for an email service, but nothing in the evidence documents a Gmail control for it. Community posts mention turning off AI features and a Workspace-wide Smart Features opt-in. These are adjacent AI/personalization settings, not a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
